name: Easy
description: This eclectic, star-studded anthology follows diverse Chicagoans fumbling through the modern maze of love, sex, technology and culture. First dates, friends with benefits, couples with kids. Whatever your relationship status is, it's always complicated.

videos.title: The F**King Study
videos.overview: A career-driven mom and her stay-at-home husband try to spice up their sex life after a spirited debate at a party leads to an awkward realization.

videos.title: Vegan Cinderella
videos.overview: After a passionate night with a vegan activist, a sheltered student abandons her bacon-eating, carbon-emitting ways.

videos.title: Brewery Brothers
videos.overview: Stuck in a boring office job, an expectant father starts an underground brewery with his stoner brother and keeps it a secret from his wife.

videos.title: Controlada
videos.overview: Tension brews between a couple who are trying to conceive when the wife's hard-partying friend comes to town and camps out on their couch.

videos.title: Art and Life
videos.overview: A middle-aged graphic novelist who mines his personal life for material gets a taste of his own medicine when he meets a photography student.

videos.title: Utopia
videos.overview: After discovering the wonders of Tinder, a curious couple goes looking for a threesome and gets a proposition from a friend.

videos.title: Chemistry Read
videos.overview: In the wake of a breakup, a young actress embraces a future filled with possibilities, while her co-star confronts the realities of growing older.

videos.title: Hop Dreams
videos.overview: A persistent reporter drives a wedge between two business owners who have different visions for the future of their operation.

videos.title: Package Thief
videos.overview: Neighbors in an affluent community take matters into their own hands when they spy a baseball-capped thief stealing packages off their doorsteps.

videos.title: Open Marriage
videos.overview: After talking it through in therapy, married parents Andi and Kyle explore an open relationship. On night one, they each test the waters.

videos.title: Side Hustle
videos.overview: A stand-up comedian who drives a cab and a sex-positive feminist writer hustle to make a living while chasing their creative dreams.

videos.title: Spent Grain
videos.overview: While the brewery brothers -- now dads -- grapple with growing pains, their wives launch their own business selling organic dog treats.

videos.title: Conjugality
videos.overview: Jacob tries to reconnect with his estranged ex-wife when he releases a new edition of his first graphic novel, which chronicled his infidelity.

videos.title: Prodigal Daughter
videos.overview: A teenager turns the tables on her wealthy parents when they force her to go to church every week as a punishment.

videos.title: Lady Cha Cha
videos.overview: A budding burlesque dancer challenges her girlfriend's double standards about art, sex and feminism.

videos.title: Baby Steps
videos.overview: Burned by a recent breakup, a woman finds joy baby-sitting for a friend in need and contemplates a new kind of domestic arrangement.

videos.title: Swipe Right
videos.overview: Andi and Kyle have an open marriage, but Kyle's the only one seeing other people -- until Andi runs into an old friend at a dinner party.

videos.title: Private Eyes
videos.overview: Hugh, a low-level employee at the U-Spy Store, jumps at the chance to go undercover at a BDSM party, dutifully researching his role as a submissive.

videos.title: Spontaneous Combustion
videos.overview: When Chase and Jo's lease is up, Chase admits she's not ready to be in a committed relationship. But making a clean break isn't easy.

videos.title: Yes
videos.overview: Tired of being single, Annie decides to say yes to everyone who asks her out for 30 days -- and finds herself battling dating fatigue.

videos.title: Swipe Left
videos.overview: Kyle feels threatened by Andi's relationship with Ryan. But a change of heart forces both Kyle and Andi to take a hard look at their feelings.

videos.title: Blank Pages
videos.overview: Self-absorbed professor Jacob learns that a former student is penning an unflattering graphic novel about their relationship.

videos.title: Number One Seller
videos.overview: To avoid giving up a percentage of his sales, street vendor Scrap splits off from his boss and recruits his friend Cool to mount a rival operation.

videos.title: Low Rolling Boil
videos.overview: When the police bust Jeff for running a bar in his garage, Jeff's estranged brother Matt offers him a job at his rival brewery.

videos.title: She's Back
videos.overview: When Sophie learns that her TV show was canceled, she has second thoughts about the ex she left behind to pursue her acting dreams.
